name: SQLite Browser
description: Browse and query SQLite databases in Orca's editor: tables, views and schema, SQL queries, column filters and sorting, copy and CSV export. Read-only.

screenshots.caption: Query, sort and filter

screenshots.caption: Every table, view, index and trigger
